decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt fits closely with the firm's core dairy range and its public recognition makes management reluctant to reverse the launch so soon.
This cheese was featured on the home page, signaling visible commitment, and as a close extension of the established cheese business it is likely to be retained.
Although only mentioned briefly, the semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the firm's core offer and there is no clear evidence yet that would force management to admit a failed launch.
The spicy cheese appears to be a modest line extension with limited public commitment, but in a growing market management would still tend to give it more time rather than withdraw it quickly.
The firm explicitly presented this mild creamy soft cheese as part of its new offer, so the public framing and fit with the existing portfolio support continuation.
The washed-rind soft cheese has less visible backing than some other launches, yet it remains close to the established business and management is likely to persist absent clear failure.
